🌴 XTREME JET SKI WATERSPORTS ST. PETERSBURG, FL

Jet ski the Gulf Coast like a local — fast, safe, and unforgettable.

🕘 Open Daily: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Check Availability & Book 📞 Call Now

Captain Mike's Guided Expeditions

Explore hidden islands, dolphin hotspots, and pristine sandbars with a local expert. Captain Mike leads every tour—so you get safe navigation, prime wildlife spotting, and professional photo stops without the guesswork.

Wildlife & Dolphin Spotting Hidden Island Access Safety-First Training 🚤 Book Now — 2-Hour Guided Expedition Learn More We specialize in guided expeditions. Bay free-ride sessions are offered only when available.
Before booking your appointment, make sure to take your temporary boater’s license.

Book an appointment.

All Operators born January 1st, 1988 or later MUST complete the ONLINE Boaters License PRIOR to arrival. Florida State Law requires all operators must pass an approved boaters safety course. TEST IS ONLY AVAILABLE FOR 90 days.  Valid State Issued ID also required upon arrival. ( For international Guests a Valid Photo Passport is also acceptable. )

1. Must be age 18+ to rent.

2. Those age 14+ are permitted to be on a jet ski. The parent or guardian is required to be on the machine and they will be required to sign a consent form.

3. Valid photo ID and a temporary boating license is required to rent.

4. Up to 2 people per jet ski.

5. Max weight is 400 lbs. (The more weight you put on jet ski, the harder to maneuver.)

6. Physical requirements: Must be able to lift oneself out of water in the event you fall off.

Jet Ski the Best Waters in St. Pete

Starting at $100 per ski

Brand new Yamaha WaveRunners with premium audio • Local professional guide included free of charge • Hidden island routes • Fast, safe jet skis • The nicest riding areas in Florida

🌊 Almost No No-Wake Zones
Enjoy your entire time on the water — not 20 minutes idling to get there 🏁 Unrestricted Riding Areas
Open water, smooth runs, and room to ride — not a tiny roped-off circle 🎯 Tailored to YOU
Relaxed cruise, high-speed fun, island hopping, or wildlife — we build the ride around your vibe 🗺️ Real Local History & Scenery
Learn the stories behind the islands, waterways, and landmarks 🚀 Modern, High-Performance Skis
Smooth, powerful Yamaha WaveRunners with audio ⭐ Owner-Operated, Not Corporate
Hospitality-driven service every ride Book Your Ride Now Beginner-friendly • Safety briefing included • No hidden fees

🏝️ Xtreme Jetski Watersports

  • St. Petersburg, FL
  • (813) 538-4802
  • Open Daily: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
https://xtremestpete.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/IslandTime.mp4

🌊 The Fun Starts Here

Your adventure starts on the water.
From hidden sandbars to island paradises, we’ll take you beyond the shoreline and into the unforgettable.

Hit the water. Feel the rush. Make waves. Make memories.

👉 Book your island tour now — the Gulf is calling.!

🌴✨ Your Private Island-Hopping Escape Awaits

Trade the crowds for crystal-clear waters and secluded island gems. With Xtreme Jetski Watersports, you’re not just booking a ride — you’re unlocking a professionally guided adventure through Florida’s most stunning coastal treasures.

Cruise to iconic spots like Egmont Key, Shell Key, Ft. De Soto, and hidden sandbars only locals know. Swim in turquoise shallows, soak up the sun on pristine shores, and explore wild, untouched beauty — all under the expert guidance of someone who knows these waters like the back of their hand.

Whether you're looking to relax, explore, or crank up the thrill — this is your Gulf Coast getaway, redefined.

🎯 Ready to experience Florida like never before?
Book your island tour online now — the water's perfect, and the adventure’s just getting started.
